name: Toeloop
summary: Toe-assisted jump launched from a backward outside edge using the free toe pick. In 16-frame clips, the model identifies the rear glide setup and direct hip alignment prior to toe impact.
keyCue: Minimal upper-body counter-rotation before the free foot reaches back to plant the toe pick.

name: Salchow
summary: Edge jump initiated from the backward inside edge of one foot and landed on the backward outside edge of the opposite foot, driven by a wide sweeping drive of the free leg.
keyCue: Three-turn or Mohawks entry followed by a pronounced circular sweep of the free leg before lift-off.

name: Flip
summary: Toe-pick jump taken off from a shallow backward inside edge. Distinguishing Flip from Lutz depends on the entry trajectory prior to the pick plant.
keyCue: Straight or slight inside entry curve after a three-turn or Mohawk before the free toe pick strikes the ice.

name: Loop
summary: Pure edge jump taking off from a deep backward outside edge and landing on the same backward outside edge, with the free leg crossed in front at takeoff.
keyCue: Crossed-leg backward sit preparation with both skates on the ice until upward spring.

name: Lutz
summary: Counter-rotated toe jump launched from a long backward outside edge. The skater rotates in the air opposite to the direction of the entry curve.
keyCue: Long diagonal backward glide on a clear outside edge with counter-rotated shoulders prior to toe pick.

name: Axel
summary: The only competitive jump initiated from a forward takeoff edge, requiring an extra half-revolution in the air compared to other jumps of the same number.
keyCue: Forward outside takeoff posture with distinct knee bend and upward drive of the free knee and arms.

name: CamelSpin
summary: One-foot spin in which the free leg is extended backward with the knee held at or above hip level, forming a horizontal line parallel to the ice.
keyCue: Sustained horizontal torso-and-free-leg silhouette across multiple consecutive temporal frames.

name: SitSpin
summary: Low one-foot spin where the skating knee is deeply flexed so the hip of the spinning leg is no higher than the skating knee.
keyCue: Compact low center of mass near the ice surface with rapid stationary rotation (as seen in contoh.mp4).

name: UprightSpin
summary: Spin performed with an extended skating leg and upright or arched torso position, including layback, Biellmann, and scratch spin variations.
keyCue: Vertical narrow rotational column with minimal spatial translation across the rink.

name: NoBasic
summary: Rotational spin elements that transition between positions or hold intermediate non-basic angles outside the strict Camel, Sit, or Upright definitions.
keyCue: Continuous stationary ice rotation with transitional or intermediate hip-to-knee geometry.

name: Sequence
summary: Step and choreographic sequences combining twizzles, brackets, rockers, counters, choctaws, and spirals across the full length or width of the ice surface.
keyCue: High horizontal camera pan across the ice combined with rapid edge changes and multi-turn footwork.
